info.title: OpenMemory API
info.description: AI Agent Memory Framework with persistent storage, intelligent retrieval, and temporal knowledge graph capabilities.

get.description:
获取组织角色列表。

返回指定组织下所有可用角色（内置角色 + 自定义角色）。

Args:
    org_id: 组织标识。
    request: FastAPI 请求对象。

Returns:
    包含角色列表的字典。

schema.title: Response Get Org Roles Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Roles Get

get.description:
获取组织权限矩阵。

返回指定组织内各角色的权限详情。

Args:
    org_id: 组织标识。
    request: FastAPI 请求对象。

Returns:
    包含权限矩阵的字典。

schema.title: Response Get Org Permissions Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Permissions Get

get.description:
查询用户在组织内的角色。

Args:
    org_id: 组织标识。
    user_id: 用户标识。
    request: FastAPI 请求对象。

Returns:
    包含用户角色信息的字典。

schema.title: Response Get User Role Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Users  User Id  Role Get

put.description:
修改用户角色（仅 org_admin）。

仅组织管理员可调用此接口修改用户角色。

Args:
    org_id: 组织标识。
    user_id: 用户标识。
    request: FastAPI 请求对象，需包含 JSON body
        {"role": "目标角色名"}。

Returns:
    操作结果字典。

Raises:
    HTTPException: 非 org_admin 角色或请求体缺少 role 字段时抛出。

schema.title: Response Set User Role Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Users  User Id  Role Put

post.description:
Store a new memory.

Extracts entities, relations, and temporal expressions from the content,
then routes to the appropriate storage backend.

S2-T1/T2（§2.3 事实源唯一）：IdentityGate 已裁决出 principal 时，把
(tenant_code, owner) 域显式透传给 service，确保 agent/受信 user 写入
落在 X-Tenant-ID / principal 域；无 principal（匿名/本地 body user）时不传，
由 service 内部按既有主体字段推导（单机兼容不回退）。

Recall memories matching a query.

Uses auto-routing to select the optimal retrieval strategy,
or the specified strategy if provided.
Supports include_waypoints for retrieval path tracing (v6.6.0).
v7.0: strategy=fusion emits a business span (TD-v7.0-007).
CR-003: 携带 session_id 时先做会话归属校验，跨域统一 404。

Forget (delete) memories.

Supports deletion by memory_id, query match, or entire session.
CR-003: 按 session_id 整段清空前先做会话归属校验，跨域统一 404。

Improve/consolidate memories.

Supports operations like promoting session memories to persistent storage.

get.description: Get a specific memory by ID.

Get decay configuration for the current tenant (v6.6.0).

Reads from PostgreSQL (OB-M3, per-tenant persistence); falls back to
defaults when no row exists.

put.description:
Update decay configuration for the current tenant (v6.6.0).

Persists to PostgreSQL (OB-M3) and refreshes the in-memory
app.state.decay_config plus the live DecayEngine config (OB-M5),
so the decay strategy reacts immediately.

get.description: Get recall trace details by trace ID (v6.6.0).

post.description:
Upload an image memory (v6.6.0).

Accepts multipart/form-data with file and optional metadata.

Search image memories by text query (v6.6.0).

Uses CLIP text embedding to find similar images (OB-M2, 方案 B：
独立 openmemory_images 集合向量检索；软删图像经 is_active 过滤）。

Generate an embedding for an uploaded image (v6.7.0).

Accepts multipart/form-data with an image file and returns
the CLIP embedding vector. Uses the CLIPEmbeddingService
with LRU caching and graceful fallback.

Background task: records embedding stats for monitoring.

get.description:
Get monitor metrics for a specified time range (v6.7.0).

Supports the following time ranges:
- ``1h``: Last hour (1-minute granularity)
- ``6h``: Last 6 hours (5-minute granularity)
- ``24h``: Last 24 hours (15-minute granularity)
- ``7d``: Last 7 days (1-hour granularity)
- ``30d``: Last 30 days (4-hour granularity)

v6.7.0 | FE-012 | Monitor page time range support

List sessions scoped to the current (tenant_code, owner) domain.

RA-05（OM-1）：仅返回当前请求域内的会话；按 last_accessed 倒序分页，
不再全量遍历所有会话。

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Sessions Get

get.description:
Get a specific session by ID (scoped to the caller's domain).

RA-05（OM-1）：会话不属于当前域（跨域）或不存在 → 404。

post.description:
Terminate (clear) a session and all its memories.

RA-05（OM-1）：仅允许终止当前请求域内的会话；跨域 → 404。

schema.title: Response 200 Terminate Session Api V1 Sessions  Session Id  Terminate Post

post.description:
Transcribe an audio file using Whisper (v6.7.1).

Accepts multipart/form-data with an audio file (mp3/wav/ogg, max 30MB).
Returns the transcribed text, segments, duration, and detected language.

Store a memory from transcribed audio text (v6.7.1).

The audio file reference (audio_file_id) is included in metadata.

get.description:
完整健康检查端点，返回所有依赖的健康状态。

需要所有依赖（向量存储、元数据存储、会话存储）均健康
才返回 200，否则返回 503。

就绪检查端点，只检查必选依赖。

用于 Kubernetes 就绪探针（readinessProbe）。
必选依赖包括：向量存储、元数据存储、会话存储。
所有必选依赖健康即返回 200。

存活检查端点，进程级健康检查。

用于 Kubernetes 存活探针（livenessProbe）。
仅验证进程是否存活，始终返回 200。
Health check alias under /api/v1 prefix (frontend compatibility).
